_meta.description: Limits and correction text for .claude/hooks/ask-question-shape-hook.js (#3233). Claude Code renders AskUserQuestion question text in bold, so context belongs in markdown printed before the call, not in the question. maxOptions and maxHeaderLength are the tool's own hard limits (#3198); maxQuestionLength is a convention threshold: one sentence. Since #3440 the correction is the findings, their remedy and one pointer line; the convention lives only in Reference/AskUserQuestion-Shape.md.

remedy.singleSelect: Print the context as ordinary markdown before the call, keep `question` to one sentence, and put long per-option content in that option's `preview`.
remedy.multiSelect: Print the context as ordinary markdown before the call, keep `question` to one sentence, and keep short option descriptions. Previews render only for single-select questions, so none are suggested here.

pointer: Templates, the context table and previews: `{frameworkPath}/Reference/AskUserQuestion-Shape.md`.
